shortDescription: Prepare for a walk, keep a private journal with photos, and import your own GPX route geometry.
longDescription:
Prepare and remember your walks with TrailNest. Build a personal checklist, keep a journal with notes, ratings, favourites and private photo copies, and import or export a single continuous GPX route or track. Choose miles or kilometres, light or dark appearance, and an app language.

Start, pause and finish a walk recording when your device provides suitable location data. Distance is an estimate and may be incomplete. Interrupted recordings recover paused. View progress along imported geometry, with accuracy and stale-location checks. Compatible installed voices can read progress aloud; voice commands currently recognise explicit English phrases and depend on the installed recognition service. Touch alternatives remain available.

Imported routes are private and unreviewed. Offline geometry packs contain route geometry, not basemap tiles or reviewed directions. No curated route catalogue, licensed basemaps, validated turn-by-turn navigation or emergency monitoring is provided. The free tier supports one marked geometry pack. The annual Premium integration lifts only that pack limit; it has passed Live App Testing, but production billing is not yet configured and remains disabled in the normal release build.

Journal entries, checklists, imported routes and preferences stay on your device. Private photo copies have location metadata removed. Optional plan sharing opens the system share sheet; it does not automatically contact anyone. Amazon account and receipt identifiers are sent over HTTPS for purchase verification when billing is enabled. No advertising or analytics is implemented.
features: Keep a private journal with notes, ratings and photos
Import and export your own GPX route geometry
Record estimated walk duration and distance on compatible devices
Choose your app language, units and appearance
releaseNotes: Android 0.8.5 development candidate: app language selection, background walk recording, private journal and GPX tools. Test 2 purchase, accelerated renewals, server-side expiry and final expired-state offline checks completed. Commercial release gates remain open.
